name: Steady-state insulation heat-leak measurement at 78 K / 293 K (NASA Cryostat-100 procedure)
plain_name: Measure heat leaking through cryogenic tank insulation
description: Measure heat leaking through cryogenic tank insulation. A bounded, source-grounded procedure profile; compatibility covers the listed checks and does not guarantee measured scientific performance.

sources.citation: Cryogenics Test Laboratory at NASA Kennedy Space Center: Thermal Insulation Systems Testing (21 April 2015)

requirements.rationale: Replicate NASA's standard cold boundary. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.
Independently control the warm boundary; a cold cryostat alone is insufficient. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.

The calorimetric boiloff measurement train is essential, rather than temperature capability alone. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.

missing_information: Insulation thickness, residual gas pressure, steady-state criteria and boiloff calibration must be chosen for the specimen; this profile does not predict conductivity or certify a tank.
confirmation_note: Profile author reviewed these exact sourced conditions on 2026-10-31. The application must still require the user's review/confirmation; all edits invalidate confirmation.
